title: Striking teachers bring Mexico City to a standstill ahead of World Cup
summary: Thousands of demonstrators blocked a major avenue leading to Mexico City's Azteca Stadium on Tuesday, days before the 2026 World Cup opens at the venue, as teacher-led protests disrupted the capital.
